product_one_liner.value: CoLab provides AI-powered design-review and engineering knowledge software for mechanical engineering and hardware product-development teams, helping them capture expert feedback and make faster, better design decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: One-sentence synthesis of CoLab’s description of EngineeringOS and its intended users.

pricing_page.notes: The /pricing URL renders general site/demo and contact-form content rather than pricing plans, and the visible navigation has no pricing link.

named_customers.notes: CoLab’s announcement identifies these manufacturers as users of CoLab.

employee_band.notes: A CoLab job posting says the company has grown to a team of 250+; that falls in the 201-500 band.

hq_location.notes: The company profile identifies its headquarters as St. John’s, Canada.

founded_year.notes: CoLab’s company announcement states it was founded in 2017.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes a technical post on building AI for DFM by CoLab’s CTO and a post about engineers building AI for CAD.

public_docs.notes: CoLab’s public Help Center contains multiple article collections, including 39 articles on using CoLab.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists Senior 3D & AI Systems Software Developer.

model_provider.value: Anthropic (identified for AI features); OpenAI, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services are also identified as LLM providers in CoLab’s subprocessors list.
model_provider.notes: The Trust Center’s subprocessors list names these providers; Anthropic is specifically labeled the LLM provider for AI features.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center lists these certifications; other listed ISO standards are outside the requested set.

last_funding.notes: CoLab announced the $72 million USD Series C on November 10, 2025.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series C was announced November 10, 2025, within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live job board lists a Key Account Executive and a Business Development Representative.

launched_6mo.notes: A September 30, 2026 announcement says CoLab released a new capability called generative artifacts, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 6, 2026, CoLab announced that two Senior Vice Presidents joined.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A revenue-operations job posting names these CRM, sales-engagement, conversation-intelligence, and data-enrichment systems.
